h1: How to Choose the Best Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad: 15 Questions to Ask
quickAnswer: The best digital marketing agency in Hyderabad for your business is one that reports in leads, cost per customer and revenue — not likes; shows case studies from your industry; lets you own your ad accounts and data; names the people who will work on your account; and offers a clear scope with a short notice period. Shortlist three, run a paid trial or audit, and compare cost per customer.

sections.heading: Why is choosing an agency in Hyderabad so hard?

blocks.text: Hyderabad has hundreds of agencies, from two-person freelance teams to large networks, and most websites say the same things: "results-driven", "360-degree", "ROI-focused". Rankings titled "top 10 agencies in Hyderabad" are often paid listings. The only reliable way to choose is to ask specific questions and compare specific answers.

sections.heading: 15 questions to ask before you sign

items: What will you report each month? Look for leads, cost per lead, cost per customer, ROAS or revenue. Reach and followers alone are not enough.
Can I see two or three case studies from my industry, with numbers? Ask for a reference you can call.
What results should I realistically expect in 90 days? Good agencies give ranges and explain what they depend on. Be wary of guarantees.
How will you track leads from ads to sales? Expect GA4, Meta Conversions API, call tracking and WhatsApp tracking.
Who exactly will work on my account? Get names and roles, not just "our team".
How many accounts does my account manager handle? Overloaded managers mean slow replies.
Do you create content in-house or outsource it? In-house shoots and design usually mean faster turnaround and better consistency.
Who in your team understands my audience? For Hyderabad, ask about Telugu content, local festivals and neighbourhood targeting.
Will my ad accounts, pages, website and data be in my name? The answer must be yes.
What is the notice period? Thirty days is standard. Avoid long lock-ins without performance clauses.
Is ad spend separate from your fee, and is there any markup? You should see both numbers clearly.
What is included and what costs extra? Shoots, ad creatives, landing pages and blog posts are often extras.
What happens in the first 30 days? Expect an audit, tracking setup, a plan with targets and the first campaigns live.
How often will we meet, and how fast do you reply? Weekly updates and a monthly review are a good baseline.
What would you do differently from my current marketing? A good agency has already looked at your ads, website and profiles before the meeting.
Guaranteed rankings, "#1 on Google" or fixed lead numbers before seeing your data
Ad accounts or pages created in the agency's name
Reports full of impressions and likes with no lead or sales numbers
Very cheap packages with templated posts and no strategy
No case studies, or case studies with no numbers and no client names
Pressure to sign a 12-month contract on the first call

blocks.text: Put the shortlisted proposals side by side and score each one:

rows: Mentions your competitors, customers and current gaps
90-day targets for leads and cost per lead
Case studies with numbers in your sector

blocks.text: Price matters, but a slightly costlier agency that halves your cost per customer is the cheaper choice.

sections.heading: Should you choose a local Hyderabad agency or a remote one?

blocks.text: A local agency can visit your outlet, shoot content on site, plan activations and meet face to face — valuable for restaurants, clinics, salons, colleges and retail. For purely online businesses, a remote agency can work well if communication is strong. Many Hyderabad businesses prefer a local team that also works with national and international brands, so they get both local knowledge and wider experience.

faqs.question: How much does a digital marketing agency charge in Hyderabad?
faqs.answer: Most small and mid-sized businesses pay ₹25,000–₹75,000 a month in agency fees, plus ad spend. See our Hyderabad digital marketing cost guide.

faqs.question: Should I hire a freelancer or an agency?
faqs.answer: A freelancer suits one task, such as running ads. An agency suits multi-channel work where ads, content, design and tracking must work together.

faqs.question: How long should I give an agency to show results?
faqs.answer: Paid ads should show early signals within 30 days. SEO and brand work take 3–6 months. Agree on 90-day milestones up front.

faqs.question: Is the biggest agency always the best?
faqs.answer: No. Fit matters more than size: industry experience, a senior person on your account and clear reporting.

faqs.question: What makes Digi Carotene different?
faqs.answer: We lead with performance and growth marketing, run every digital channel with one in-house team including our own production studio, and report in leads and revenue. [Add 1–2 real proof points: client count, years, a named result.]

cta.body: Put us to the test. Get a free growth audit with specific fixes and 90-day targets — then decide.
